paragraphs.text: Your rifle kicks as you fire at the alien horror.

Make your attack roll. If you hit and score at least 12 points of 
damage  against  the  creature,  you  may  finish  it  off  while  it  lies 
stunned; go to 509. If you inflict less damage, it drops out of sight 
and you must take to your heels again; go to 510.
